text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mumu...?
What is that crowd over there?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-senpai, Air Groove-senpai!
That 2000m turf mock race the other day...
It was so inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-senpai bursts forward from a great position!
And Air Groove-senpai is fiercely chasing her down—
It's such a fierce battle, it's hard to believe it's just a mock race...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thanks!
I was able to give that race everything I had.
...Maybe because Air Groove was there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't possibly show you an embarrassing run.
So I took to the track as the 'Empress' I am."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmph...! Mmm, mmmmmm~~...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! This is unacceptable!
Why does it always have to be them?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's in the same class too, you know!
Look at Windy-chan moreee!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gnnngh~~ If that's how it is... then—!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, on to the next problem.
This equation requires applied thinking...
Is there anyone bold enough to give it a try?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Pick me, pick me, pick meee!!
Windy-chan will answer, nodano!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Windy...!?
Or rather, why the glasses...!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... How about that, don't I look smart!
Windy-chan is built different today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Watch this! I'll solve something like this in a jiffy—
............

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Teacher!
You feel like giving me a hint now, don't you?
I suppose I could accept it-noda!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As if there's such a thing!
This isn't a quiz show...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's great!
Love the enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Phew...!
Beat my previous time, huh. Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As expected. In that case, I will make a declaration too—
"I will beat you on the clock!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec!
You guys gotta race Windy-chan too~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Windy...? Hehe, what's the matter?
You seem awfully defiant today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! It's too late for regrets!
Windy-chan's got a secret plan—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've studied the way flying fish glide!
I'll swim as if I'm soaring through the air!
With this, a total victory is guaranteed, indeed~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Toh! ...Gub, blub-blub!
Water got into my mouth~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You absolute fool...!
That's what happens when you try swimming in a style you're not used to!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good grief... You scared the life out of me! Stop trying to bite us all the time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No waaaaay!
I'm gonna beat you guys and stand out even more!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's not just you guys!
More than any other Umamusume from my generation...
Windy-chan is gonna shine the brightest!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
I can't let Windy beat me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
! Y-You won't lose to her...?
You mean to Windy-chan?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Even if we race on different stages,
turf and dirt... you're still a formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Once you sink your teeth in, you never let go—that fighting spirit of yours!
It's not something just anyone can copy!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I want more people to watch me than anyone else. That's why I'm ready to sink my teeth into any opponent—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And you're able to take on challenges head-on no matter the situation.
Whether in class or in training.
...That's truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ! Incredible... Windy-chan is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, look...
You do get things wrong sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is fair to say her fighting spirit is cut from a different cloth.
...Even among our generation, that is.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Air Groove too?!
...Fuhe, kufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You guys sure have great taste~!
Showering Windy-chan with so many compliments!
A~hahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I visited the gym to check on
Shinko Windy's independent training—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh~! Not yet...! Windy-chan's just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, pushing yourself even further?!
Fufu... I won't lose to you!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're working hard alongside everyone!
Looks like you're working hard alongside everyone!
Training together, huh? You two are close.
Training together? You two are so close!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, pushing yourself even further?!
Fufu... I won't lose to you!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're working hard alongside everyone!
Looks like you're working hard alongside everyone!
Training together, huh? You two are close.
Training together? You two are so close!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
Yeah, as the strongest Umamusume of our generation,
I can't go showing any weakness!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, I can't just let that slide.
Precisely because you're a classmate, I have no intention of giving up the top spot!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fufun! If there's anything giving you trouble, I'll just have to teach you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you... I literally just pointed out that your form was wrong a moment ago.
